name: Cal.com
tagline: Open-source scheduling infrastructure for booking meetings effortlessly
description:
Self-hostable, API-driven meeting scheduling platform that syncs with Google Calendar, Outlook, and Apple Calendar. Supports time-zone conversion, collective bookings, and custom routing.

Vibecoded integrations with Astra and Claude models allow meeting attendees to schedule, reschedule, and resolve agenda conflicts over conversational chat.

replaces.note: Open-source meeting infrastructure with public booking links and white-label branding.
Eliminates back-and-forth email scheduling with personal booking links and team availability slots.
